changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.sql: create or alter view [dbo].[ResponsibilitySummary] as select cast(null as uniqueidentifier) as ResponsibilityUid, r.Id as RuleId, r.Name as RuleName, RT.Name as ResponsibilityTypeName, RT.Uid as ResponsibilityTypeUid, RT.ID as ResponsibilityTypeID, RT.[Permissions], rasset.AssetID, rasset.AssetTypeID, r.ApplyToType, r.IsVisible, rresource.SecurityType, rresource.SecurityId, cast(null as uniqueidentifier) as GroupUid, cast(null as nvarchar(250)) as GroupName, u.ResourceID, u.Uid as ResourceUid, u.FirstName + ' ' + u.LastName as ResourceName, r.Context from security.[Rule] r inner join security.RuleAssignment rasset on r.Id = rasset.RuleId and r.State = 1 inner join security.RuleOwner rresource on r.ID = rresource.RuleId and rresource.SecurityType = 2 inner join security.[Role] RT on RT.Id = r.RoleId inner join reporting.Global_Resource u on u.ResourceID = rresource.SecurityId and u.State=1 union All select cast(null as uniqueidentifier) as ResponsibilityUid, r.Id as RuleId, r.Name as RuleName, RT.Name as ResponsibilityTypeName, RT.Uid as ResponsibilityTypeUid, RT.ID as ResponsibilityTypeID, RT.[Permissions], rasset.AssetID, rasset.AssetTypeID, r.ApplyToType, r.IsVisible, rresource.SecurityType, rresource.SecurityId, G.Uid as GroupUid, G.Name as GroupName, u.ResourceID, u.Uid as ResourceUid, u.FirstName + ' ' + u.LastName as ResourceName, r.Context from security.[Rule] r inner join security.RuleAssignment rasset on r.Id = rasset.RuleId and r.State = 1 inner join security.RuleOwner rresource on r.ID = rresource.RuleId and rresource.SecurityType = 1 inner join security.[Role] RT on RT.Id = r.RoleId inner join [Group] G on G.ID = rresource.SecurityId inner join ResourceGroup RG on RG.GroupID = G.ID inner join reporting.Global_Resource u on u.ResourceID = RG.ResourceID and u.State=1 union all select oride.Id as ResponsibilityUid, 0 as RuleId, null as RuleName, RT.Name as ResponsibilityTypeName, RT.Uid as ResponsibilityTypeUid, RT.ID as ResponsibilityTypeID, RT.[Permissions], oride.AssetID, a.AssetTypeID, cast(0 as bit) as ApplyToType, cast(1 as bit) as IsVisible, oride.SecurityType, oride.SecurityId, cast(null as uniqueidentifier) as GroupUid, cast(null as nvarchar(250)) as GroupName, u.ResourceID, u.Uid as ResourceUid, u.FirstName + ' ' + u.LastName as ResourceName, oride.Context from security.[Override] oride inner join dbo.Asset a on oride.SecurityType = 2 and a.Id = oride.AssetId inner join security.[Role] RT on RT.Id = oride.RoleId inner join reporting.Global_Resource u on u.ResourceID = oride.SecurityId and u.State=1 union all select oride.Id as ResponsibilityUid, 0 as RuleId, null as RuleName, RT.Name as ResponsibilityTypeName, RT.Uid as ResponsibilityTypeUid, RT.ID as ResponsibilityTypeID, RT.[Permissions], oride.AssetID, a.AssetTypeID, cast(0 as bit) as ApplyToType, cast(1 as bit) as IsVisible, oride.SecurityType, oride.SecurityId, G.Uid as GroupUid, G.Name as GroupName, u.ResourceID, u.Uid as ResourceUid, u.FirstName + ' ' + u.LastName as ResourceName, oride.Context from security.[Override] oride inner join dbo.Asset a on oride.SecurityType = 1 and a.Id = oride.AssetId inner join security.[Role] RT on RT.Id = oride.RoleId inner join [Group] g on g.Id = oride.SecurityId inner join ResourceGroup RG on RG.GroupID = g.Id inner join reporting.Global_Resource u on u.ResourceID = RG.ResourceID and u.State=1
